title: Building Developer Products in the Agentic Age
summary:
This is a talk given by Ching-Wei Chen at the LeadDev New York Meetup on Mar 25, 2026.
The presentation uses a case study of a major Spotify outage to emphasize the need for proactive reliability and performance issue detection. It introduces Datadog APM Recommendations as a developer product that detects common anti-patterns like aggressive retries and N+1 queries. The rise of capable coding agents is "shrinking" the Software Delivery Loop, requiring a shift to building specialized tools for AI Agents.
This shift necessitates building specialized tools that are designed to be consumed directly by AI Agents, rather than just humans. Effective agent tools must be optimized to "save cognition" by compressing deep insights from vast data (like trace spans) and minimizing friction through discoverability and sensible defaults. Specialized tools for tasks like identifying latency bottlenecks have shown significant performance improvements in internal agent investigations. The talk concludes that agent tools should be efficient, broadly useful, and discoverable to achieve the simplicity of tools like grep
ja_summary:
AIエージェント時代には、人間だけでなくAIエージェントが直接利用できる、効率的で発見しやすい開発者向けツールが不可欠です。
Spotifyの障害事例から、プロアクティブな信頼性・パフォーマンス検出の重要性が強調され、Datadog APM Recommendationsのようなツールが紹介されています。
AIエージェントは開発プロセスを加速させるため、AIが「認知を節約」できるような、高度な洞察を圧縮・提供するツールの開発が求められます。
